items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh yeah, I believe Harold or Stoney or somebody told me that...

ctx.x: Well he did mention about the same night, you know, like, I guess it was me or somebody else and myself, we went up to Bunk and said, man, you know, like, this playing real quiet, this is really terrific, you know, and he said, yeah, well we really got the band getting some low gravy, he called it low gravy, which I had never heard of before.
Oh yeah, I believe Harold or Stoney or somebody told me that, it must have been that same night, yeah, he said, yeah, we got him dipping down into the low gravy tonight, as if it's
really good. Yeah, he kind of, well sometimes Bunk wouldn't acknowledge, you know, something that you might say about the band on a particular night, you know, he just kind of.
